briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI competition as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier releases this month amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over deployment risks. DialectForge integration emerges as a key protocol-level defense.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with multimodal reasoning gains; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI deploys Grok-3; DeepSeek releases R2. Model proliferation signals intense capability race.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST updates guidelines while EU AI Act enforcement begins. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm AI chip production; Microsoft and Google expand data centers in Texas and Arizona; NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q3. Sovereign compute initiatives advance in Europe and Middle East.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first company to reach 10^28 FLOP training runs achieve decisive AGI lead by 2028?
